newsitem.title: GERMANY: German stocks shade firmer, cautious ahead of U.S.
newsitem.headline: German stocks shade firmer, cautious ahead of U.S.

text.p: German shares made modest gains in early bourse trade on Friday, but traders said volumes were thin and dealings cautious ahead of the release of key U.S. data due in the early afternoon.
The DAX index of 30 blue chip shares was 4.03 points, or 0.15 percent, firmer at 2,684.78, having climbed up to 2688.28 at the session open.
U.S. September producer prices and retail sales data, due out an hour after the close of floor trade in Germany, will be eyed for clues to the U.S. inflation trend.
"This is one of those 'let's wait for the Americans' kind of days," said a Frankfurt dealer.
Some dealers said the DAX was still in a consolidation phase after a spate of record highs, while others said the index needs a downward correction.

Dealers said that interest was more focused on nedium sized stocks than on blue chips. Construction group Philipp Holzmann AG rose 12 marks, or almost four percent, to 357 marks, after forecasting break even in the current business year.
While Holzmann made gains, another construction firm, Hochtief, lost ground, slipping 1.10 marks to 69.40.
Newly founded dialysis group Fresenius Medical care gained almost three percent or 3.10 marks to rise to 116.50 after dealers said the new listing was attracting interest.
